timeline.summary: The Aureate Coterie declared war on House Malestroit.
The Jolly Sprockets answered the call to arms and joined The Aureate Coterie.
The first battle was set for 05/11/2026.
A field battle was set at Ashford for 05/11/2026 21:00 CET.
Battle of Ashford: victory for The Aureate Coterie. 23 attackers and 31 defenders fell.
Order of the Ash backed The Aureate Coterie.
A siege was set at Greywater for 07/11/2026 21:00 CET.
Battle of Greywater: victory for House Malestroit. 38 attackers and 19 defenders fell.
Battle of Highmoor was decided without a fight: victory for The Aureate Coterie. 9 attackers and 14 defenders fell.
Raid on Fenwick: victory for House Malestroit. 8 attackers and 4 defenders fell.
A siege was set at Malestroit Keep for 12/11/2026 21:00 CET.
Brume declared war on Kestrel Reach.
Battle of Fenwick: victory for Brume. 11 attackers and 17 defenders fell.
The war ended in victory for Brume. A truce holds until 13/11/2025.
Battle of the Salt Road: victory for the attackers. 13 attackers and 11 defenders fell.
Battle of Reedmere: victory for the defenders. 13 attackers and 6 defenders fell.
